sources.fullCitation: Kurt Mühlhardt mit Bernard Etté und sein Orchester. “Sagen kleine Mädels "nein".” Walzer aus dem Tonfilm „Der Korvettenkapitän“; label credit “Bronislaw Kaper – Fritz Rotter und Armin Lackenbach Robinson”. Kristall, Katalog-Nr. 78N, 1930. The description places the recording in 1930 and identifies the singer as Kurt Mühlhardt, who also recorded as Kurt Hardt. Discographic detail as given in the uploader's description; the label is not shown in the YouTube upload.
